candidates.claim: Port GigabitEthernet1/0/15 on sw-it-01, a CORP access port (VLAN 30) that is not shut down, is assigned to access VLAN 10, which is allowed only on OT-facing ports.
candidates.remediation: Return GigabitEthernet1/0/15 on sw-it-01 to access VLAN 30 and confirm that no OT device is attached to that port.

candidates.claim: The sw-it-01 configuration deviates from the approved baseline at the switchport access vlan line of interface GigabitEthernet1/0/15 (baseline VLAN 30, current VLAN 10).
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the engineer: revert the port to VLAN 30 per the baseline, or document it as an approved change and update the baseline.
